description: Illustrative lesion extents (fraction of each region damaged) for the three stroke models in Brezzo et al. (2025, J Cereb Blood Flow Metab). Based on the paper's histology summary (dMCAO and dMCAO + hypoxia: cortical, ~12% of the hemisphere; tMCAO: larger, cortex + striatum, with more hippocampal and thalamic involvement) and typical model territories. These are assumptions, not measured values. Replace them with region-by-region histology for a real analysis.
